# GitHub Repository Metadata

Use these values in the GitHub repository **About** panel to improve search discovery.

## Description

AI spam call detection and TRAI DND reporting voice agent for India using LiveKit, Sarvam STT/TTS, Gemini/OpenAI, SIP telephony, and Telegram alerts.

## About Text

This project is a personal AI call-screening system for unknown and suspected spam callers in India. It combines LiveKit telephony, Sarvam speech models, Gemini/OpenAI language models, and Telegram notifications to create a voice agent that answers calls, gathers evidence, classifies spam, and prepares TRAI DND complaint drafts for user-approved reporting.

The agent is designed for Indian spam-call workflows including credit card pitches, loan offers, insurance sales, KYC/OTP phishing, fake bank calls, real estate promotions, and unsolicited commercial communication complaints to TRAI `1909`.
